intended_object: The universe-lifted version (via GrpCat.uliftFunctor) of the canonical map of group-valued presheaves G(T)/H(T) → Q(T), induced by a homomorphism q : G → Q of group schemes over S whose kernel is H. Inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The body is `whiskerRight (yonedaQuotientMap i q h) GrpCat.uliftFunctor`. It only transports an existing map, the pointwise injective map G(T)/H(T) → Q(T), from universe u to universe u+1. This makes its source match the presheaf `yonedaQuotient i ⋙ GrpCat.uliftFunctor`, which is what gets sheafified in the construction of the fppf quotient sheaf. The mathematical content is in `yonedaQuotientMap`. This definition is a universe-bookkeeping wrapper used only in auxiliary lemmas (injectivity on each object, compatibility with the quotient map) that lead to comparing the fppf quotient sheaf G/H with Q. As a construction it is correct, since whiskering by the ulift functor is the right way to transport the map. But it has no standalone counterpart in the literature beyond the induced map itself.
